evidenceBasis: Owner screenshots from Travelpayouts Earthrightnow project showing Generate links controls.
rule: A Generate links control confirms account-side link generation is available. It does not authorize automatic public placement; ERN still requires utility review, exact-link verification and disclosure.

nextBest.why: Global eSIM utility can serve many ERN destinations with low destination-specific maintenance.
Luggage storage is highly complementary to city discovery and can be destination-agnostic.
City-pass utility fits major city destinations and can complement Tiqets/Viator without replacing them.
Transfer coverage can broaden transport beyond Welcome Pickups where destination coverage differs.
Flight-search utility can support trip planning at a global level without affecting camera ranking.
Global eSIM alternative; keep only if materially useful versus Airalo/GigSky/Yesim to avoid clutter.
